about: Names shoppers type, mapped onto the catalog. Edited by research and by the weekly search review (docs/search/WEEKLY_SEARCH_REVIEW.md). Keys: brands by brand slug, categories by exact catalog category name, products by model number. phrases rewrite a colloquial query to catalog words inside one category; rewrites are single-word spelling fixes; stopWords never need to match.
